2607.05620.title: Safe Bayesian Optimization with Counterfactual Policies
2607.05620.paper_summary: In many decision-making settings, new interventions are acceptable only if they do not reduce outcomes below some established threshold. For example, in clinical medicine, new treatments are often acceptable only if they do not worsen outcomes relative to an established standard of care. Safe Bayesian optimization maximizes an objective subject to safety constraints. In the setting that we consider here, safety is defined relative to a known baseline policy whose outcomes are counterfactual and therefore unobserved. Thus, the counterfactual outcomes of the baseline policy must be estimated and those (uncertain) estimates must be used to safely optimize the objective. We address this estimation problem by using conformal prediction to construct valid uncertainty intervals for counterfactual baseline outcomes, and we show how these intervals can be integrated into safe Bayesian optimization to ensure that constraint violations occur at or below a user-specified rate. We also show how to adapt these conformal estimates to different kinds of covariate shift. We provide a safety proof, experimental evidence, and a sensitivity analysis.
2607.05620.paper_summary_zh: 在許多決策制定的情境中，新的干預措施只有在不降低結果至某個既定閾值以下的情況下才是可接受的。<lb/>例如，在臨床醫學中，新的治療方法通常只有在不使結果相對於既定護理標準惡化的情況下才是可接受的。<lb/>安全的貝葉斯優化在安全約束條件下最大化一個目標。<lb/>在我們這裡考慮的情境中，安全性是相對於一個已知的基準政策定義的，其結果是反事實的，因此是未觀察到的。<lb/>因此，必須估計基準政策的反事實結果，並且這些（不確定的）估計必須用於安全地優化目標。<lb/>我們通過使用符合預測來解決這一估計問題，以構建反事實基準結果的有效不確定性區間，並展示如何將這些區間整合到安全的貝葉斯優化中，以確保約束違規發生在用戶指定的比率或以下。<lb/>我們還展示了如何將這些符合估計調整為不同類型的協變量變化。<lb/>我們提供了一個安全性證明、實驗證據和敏感性分析。
